notice.title: Windows 10/11 app launch issues & Smart App Control workaround
notice.content: If Windows 10/11 or Smart App Control stops you from launching the app, follow the workaround here.
notice.full_content:
False-positive reports were submitted to Microsoft for `installer.exe` and `InnioasisUpdater.exe` and actioned, but if Windows Endpoint Protection or Smart App Control is still blocking the application on your computer, use this workaround:
### Temporary Workaround: Turn Smart App Control Off 1. Open Windows **Settings** (press `Win + I`). 2. Go to **Privacy & security** > **Windows Security** > **App & browser control**. 3. Under **Smart App Control**, click **Smart App Control settings**. 4. Set Smart App Control to **Off**. This immediately allows the app to open and run.
If Windows or Edge prevents you from downloading Updater CE, click more options (**…**) then **Keep** > **Show more** > **Keep anyway**.
### Re-enabling Smart App Control When false-positive definitions finish updating on your computer, you can re-enable Smart App Control via the Windows Registry: 1. Press **Windows Key + R**, type `regedit`, and press Enter to open Registry Editor as administrator. 2. Navigate to: `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI\Policy` (or `Policies`). 3. Locate `VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState` in the right-hand pane. 4. Double-click `VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState` and change its Value data to: - `1` = On (Enforced) - `2` = Evaluation Mode 5. Click OK, close the Registry Editor, and restart your computer.
[See the installer.exe report to Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/submission/45d25b9c-0dd6-4d01-afd2-f0ea6b224dfd) [See the InnioasisUpdater.exe report to Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/submission/1aef842b-3fda-44e7-bcfb-1a64af3ea661)

notice.title: Rockbox Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates 0.5 and is not compatible with Y1 units shipped with firmware 3.0.7 or later. Flashing will prevent booting.
notice.full_content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates version 0.5. It is not compatible with Innioasis Y1 hardware shipped after March 2026 with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 pre-installed. Flashing this legacy build on those devices will prevent booting until restored via [Updater CE's SP Flash Tool engine](https://innioasis.app/Troubleshooting/recover-non-booting-device.html#sp-flash-tool-engine).

notice.title: Original Software Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7 and will prevent booting on newer Y1 hardware until a compatible build is installed.
notice.full_content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7. It is not compatible with Y1 units manufactured with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 or later. Flashing it will leave the device in a non-booting state until 3.0.7 or higher is installed using [Updater CE's SP Flash Tool engine](https://innioasis.app/Troubleshooting/recover-non-booting-device.html#sp-flash-tool-engine).
